supportedActions.description: Compute the effect of adding or removing permission rules, without writing anything.
Editing the spec and running sync is the only way to apply; applying through the API needs revision checks, approval, and rollback first.

effects.default: No rule; the tool's default applies

resolution.agent-scope: The subject's own spec (can, tools, readonly, or mcpServers) decides this, on a tool that writes that narrowing.
resolution.disabled: The server's spec sets disabled: true, and the tool honors it or never receives the server.
resolution.hook: A generated hook checks the action before the tool runs it.
resolution.no-rule: No rule names this action; the tool's own default decides.
resolution.not-expressed: The specs decide this, but sync writes nothing for it on this tool, so the tool's own default applies.
resolution.translated: The adapter writes the winning rule in the tool's own format, and this repository documents how the tool matches that rule form.
resolution.translated-unverified: The adapter writes a rule, but this repository does not document how the tool matches that rule form, so the effect stays unresolved.

lists.ask: The tool asks before running it.
lists.can: The agent's neutral capability list; anything it leaves out is unavailable to the agent.
lists.mcpServers: The MCP servers the agent may reach; any other server is unavailable to it.
lists.protected: A protected path from a settings spec: edits ask first or are blocked, by the block's decision.
lists.readonly: readonly: true leaves out edits, writes, and deletes.
lists.tools: The agent's tool list in tool names; anything it leaves out is unavailable to the agent.

enforcement.hook: A generated hook carries the decision.
enforcement.native-rule: The tool's own configuration carries the decision.
enforcement.not-applicable: There is no decision to carry, such as when no rule applies.
enforcement.not-expressed: Sync writes nothing for this decision on the tool; its own defaults apply.

installed.in-sync: The generated file matches what sync would write.
installed.not-applicable: No generated file carries this decision.
installed.not-checked: Generated files were not compared with disk.
installed.not-generated: Sync has not written the file yet; run sync.
installed.stale: The generated file differs from what sync would write; run sync.

rights.discover: Whether the subject can learn that the secret exists and what it is called.
rights.manage: Whether the subject can rotate or revoke the secret.
rights.not-readable: The configuration keeps the value out of the subject's reach.
rights.readValue: Whether the subject can read the secret's value.
rights.unavailable: The subject's scope or the provider's status leaves this right out.
rights.unknown: The configuration does not decide this right.
rights.use: Whether the subject can act with the secret through the provider that references it.
